findings.title: 558 comment units in the s4 cells carry a sentence over 40 words (C5)
findings.claim: Of the 3367 D5 comment units in custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/{j..z}*.py and www/*.js, 558 (16.6 %, in 45 of 51 files) hold at least one sentence over 40 words, 716 such sentences in all, the longest 156 words.
findings.mechanism: Comments and docstrings grow by appended clauses (dashes, semicolons, parentheticals) rather than new sentences; nothing in the gate measures sentence length, so criterion C5 has no detector.

findings.title: text_ledger.py reports wrong line numbers for 737 of 892 card comment units
findings.claim: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:scan_c_like drops one line from its counter each time a JavaScript quote is cut off at a newline, so 737 of the card's 892 D5 units carry a line up to 11 lines away from where the unit sits.
findings.mechanism: In the string branch, an unterminated ' or " (an apostrophe inside a regex literal or a comment-adjacent token) breaks at the newline and sets i = j + 1, consuming the newline without line += 1; the drift accumulates down the file. Unit ids hash the text and are unaffected, but every ledger 'line' column and any harness locating code beside a unit by that line reads the wrong place (this seat's own adjacent-constant check did until it relocated units).

evidence.unit: units whose reported line is not their file line
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: one-line instrument edit, applied in memory by ledger_lines.py --patched: in scan_c_like's string loop, 'break' -> 'line += 1; break' for an unterminated non-template quote
perturbation.observed_value: misplaced_units 737 -> 1, max_offset 11 -> 1 (the residual 1 is a locator tie)
